summary.text: Zak Wittenhagen is the Republican candidate for the Hawaii House of Representatives, District 4, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging Democratic incumbent Greggor Ilagan.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a community advocate and nonprofit founder running to represent Puna.

paragraphs.text: Zak Wittenhagen said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is originally from Lakeland, Florida, and founded the Hugs Not Drugs organization in 2024.

He said the nonprofit supports people seeking recovery from addiction by guiding them through the rehabilitation system and connecting them with resources, and that he also works as a local delivery driver.
He said he has used public assistance programs including SSI and SNAP.
Wittenhagen advanced from the Republican primary on August 8, 2026.
His listed campaign messages were that he comes from poverty rather than money, is a community advocate, and will fight for Puna, and he named housing and infrastructure as his policy interests.
